strengths: Every technical term (system, context, inference, tools) is defined at the exact moment it does causal work in the running scenario, so no glossary accumulates.
The single worked example consistently returns to mechanism—showing why the first answer was narrow, what the model could and could not do, and how new context changed the output.

summary: The introduction and opening chapter execute the reader job well: a warm, human-stakes scenario opens a genuine curiosity gap, the centre of the chapter traces the causal pipeline from prompt through context, inference and tools to output, the click (repair the weak part, not the confidence) is earned after the mechanism, and the ending lands on a bounded, precise distinction. The bounded job-offer example serves the broader foundational purpose rather than becoming it, terms are defined in use, confidence is proportionate to evidence, and no failure family from the rubric is actually present.
